description: This header file declares functions related to handling value change events in the rbus system, specifically for adding/removing property nodes and closing handles.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_AddPropertyNode
methods.description: Adds a property node for handling value changes in rbus.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_RemovePropertyNode
methods.description: Removes a property node associated with value change handling.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes a rbus handle related to value change subscriptions.
